descriptor: Outdoor clothing and boots for autumn

voice.summary: Sounds like a shopkeeper in a waxed jacket: straightforward, tactile and fond of weather. It names cloth and cuts plainly and keeps menu words to one or two syllables.
dos: Name fabrics and products plainly, such as wool, waxed cotton, boots
Keep menu labels to one word where possible
Use weather as the hook, not discounts
donts: Do not use fashion hype like must-have
Do not bury categories under clever names

taglines: Wool, waxed cotton and good boots
Dressed for the turn of the year
boilerplate: Fellgate is an outdoor clothing shop selling wool knitwear, waxed cotton jackets and sturdy boots for autumn walks, with simple navigation designed for a phone in a pocket.
